label: D1 near the end of the episode, after a rewarded a2 streak (very sparse)
explanation: Extremely sparse: 34 activations in 28 of 155737 windows (29 steps in 23 dev windows), all weak (max 0.08). Every activation is at D1 with reward input 1, prev_action a2, in episode trials 90-99 (mostly 97+), start_high=1, good mostly S2, value in its lowest bin (value drops at the end of the episode), and usually after a run of rewarded a2 choices. It never fires at GO or D2, or after an unrewarded trial or an a1 choice. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables and the episode position, and covers all dev activations (recall 1.0), but precision is about 0.02: most matching steps do not activate, so the context is necessary but far from sufficient. Too few activations to explain further or to make magnitude claims.
